ACT IX OF 2011
ACT IX OF 2011
PARTITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the
Partition Act, 1893
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
2nd May, 2011
No.PAP-Legis-2(62)/2011/387, dated 2-5-2011.---The Partition (Amendment)
Bill 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 30
March 2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 30 April 2011, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.- Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Partition Act, 1893 (IV of 1893), for purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1)
This Act may be cited as the Partition (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 1 of Act IV of 1893

Preamble.- Whereas it is

It is enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment in section 1 of Act IV of 1893.- In the
Partition Act, 1893 (IV of 1893), in section 1-
(i) in subsection (2), for the word "Pakistan", the words "the Punjab" shall be substituted; and
(ii) in
subsection (4), for the words "immovable property paying revenue to
Government", the words "agricultural land" shall be substituted.
